findings.entity: coffee mugs on counter (man's mug and the second mug handled by the waitress)
findings.description: From ~01:10 to ~01:12.6 two distinct white mugs are visible side by side: the man holds one and the waitress's hand slides/holds a second one right beside it. Over ~01:12.6-01:13 the second mug slides into the man's mug and the two merge into a single mug; from 01:13 onward only one mug exists, and nobody lifts the second one off the counter or out of frame.

findings.entity: the man's truck parked outside the diner
findings.description: In the opening exterior (00:00-00:10) the only vehicle at the diner is a white conventional tractor cab with no trailer. When the man leaves (01:41-01:49) he walks to a dark-green truck pulling a dark-green box body with a white stripe, parked as the same lone vehicle he arrived in. No other truck is shown arriving and the white tractor is never seen leaving, so the vehicle's color and body type appear to have changed.
